# Bun: timestamp

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To use the timestamp property in Bun, access the ConsoleAPICalledEventDataType.timestamp field with SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for property name, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for type, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for parent object, and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for valid values. Agents need this to quickly reference timestamp properties without reading the full docs.

Search intents:
- Bun timestamp
- Bun ConsoleAPICalledEventDataType
- Bun inspector runtime

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/bun-timestamp --json
